name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Transfer entries are clearer: the auto-written note ("From ..." / "To ...") and the small grey text under the Bank column now name the account holder instead of the bank brand, so it's obvious at a glance whose account the money moved to or from.

Login page background refined further: the gold light beams behind the glass card now flow and ripple with a subtle woven texture, matching the gold-and-black look used across the rest of the app. Same sign-in form, same security behind it — just a new look.

Fixed a misleading login error: if too many people log in from the same network at once and Supabase's own protection kicks in, the login page used to say "incorrect password" — it now says there were too many attempts from your network and to wait a bit, which is what's actually happening.
